exceptions.rationale: Vulnerable minimatch versions are reached through the TypeScript ESLint and Jest development toolchains. These tools match patterns from repository configuration. The production audit reports no findings.
exceptions.remediation: Remove this exception once supported versions of TypeScript ESLint and Jest resolve patched minimatch versions.

exceptions.rationale: Affected glob versions are reached through the Jest development toolchain, which walks repository paths during local and CI tests. Jest 30.5.2 uses glob 13, and test-exclude uses glob 10. The production audit reports no findings.
exceptions.remediation: Remove this exception once supported versions of Jest and test-exclude resolve patched glob versions.
